info.title: bird
info.description: Deploy and run containers on a bird server. Browse these docs at /docs. Every endpoint except the docs needs the API token from birdd's data directory as a bearer token.

post.summary: Sign in with a username and password, and a code when two-factor is on

200.description: Signed in, or asked for a two-factor code; with `cookie` the session is set as an HttpOnly `bird_session` cookie, marked Secure unless the browser is on this host, and requests using it that change something or open a terminal must send an Origin matching the Host

429.description: Too many failed sign-ins, wait before trying again

post.summary: Sign out the session this request came in with

204.description: Signed out, and the session cookie cleared

400.description: The request used an api token, not a session

get.summary: Show who the token belongs to

200.description: The token's user and role

200.description: Orgs with your role in each

200.description: Backups of every service, newest first

post.summary: Deploy an image, creating the service on first deploy

409.description: Conflicting state or operation in progress

200.description: Services in the default environment

parameters.name: stats

200.description: The service, its active deployment and machines

delete.summary: Remove a service and its machines

parameters.description: Also delete the service's volumes and the data on them; required when it has any

409.description: Conflicting state or operation in progress

get.summary: List backups of a service, newest first

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Service name, also of a removed service

200.description: Backups, newest first

post.summary: Back up a service's volumes

201.description: Every volume copied while the machines were paused

409.description: The service has no volumes, or another operation is in progress

put.summary: Back up a service's volumes on a schedule

200.description: Schedule saved; the first backup runs within a minute when none was scheduled before

409.description: The service has no volumes

delete.summary: Stop backing up a service on a schedule, keeping the backups it made
Delete a backup and its archives

post.summary: Replace a service's volume data with a backup

200.description: Data restored and machines started again; the replaced data is kept as a new backup

409.description: The backup does not fit the service, or another operation is in progress

post.summary: Build an image from source

parameters.name: dockerfile
parameters.description: Dockerfile path inside the context, Dockerfile by default

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Dockerfile ARG values as a JSON object of strings

requestBody.description: Build context as a tar archive, optionally gzipped, at most 512 MiB

200.description: Newline-delimited JSON stream of BuildEvent, ending with built or failed

get.summary: Open a TCP connection to the service's port, for `bird connect`

parameters.name: machine
parameters.description: Machine id, or the end of one; left out, the first running machine

101.description: Switched to bird-tcp: the connection now carries the bytes of a TCP connection to the service's port

404.description: Service or machine not found, or nothing running

426.description: The request did not ask to upgrade to bird-tcp

502.description: The machine did not accept the connection

get.summary: List a service's cron jobs with their next and last run

200.description: Jobs by name; times are unix seconds and schedules are UTC

get.summary: List a cron job's runs, newest first

200.description: The latest runs, newest first

post.summary: Run a cron job now

202.description: The run started; poll it for its status and output

404.description: Service or job not found, or the service was never deployed

409.description: The job is already running

503.description: Too many cron jobs are running

get.summary: Show a cron run with the end of its output

200.description: The run; output is the last 64 KiB, or why a skipped run did not start

404.description: Service, job or run not found

get.summary: List deployments

200.description: Deployments, newest first

get.summary: What a deploy did: build output, birdd's steps, the release command and new machines' output

parameters.name: follow
parameters.description: Keep the response open and send new lines while the deploy runs

200.description: The log; with follow=true a newline-delimited JSON stream of DeployLogLine that ends with the deploy

get.summary: List domains of a service

200.description: Domains routed to the service, with where each one's certificate stands

post.summary: Route a domain to a service

201.description: Domain added, returns all domains of the service

409.description: Conflicting state or operation in progress

put.summary: Send a domain's visitors to another domain of the service, or back to the app

400.description: The target is not another domain of this service, or redirects itself

delete.summary: Stop routing a domain to a service

post.summary: Run a command in a running machine

200.description: Newline-delimited JSON stream of CommandEvent, ending with exited or failed

get.summary: Run a command in a running machine with its stdin, stdout and stderr passed through as bytes

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The command as a JSON array of strings, like `["pg_dump","-Fc","app"]`

parameters.name: machine
parameters.description: Machine id, or the end of one; left out, the first running machine

101.description: Switched to bird-tty without a terminal: the client sends data (0, stdin) and eof (5, empty) once its stdin ends; birdd sends data (0, stdout) and stderr (4) as written, then exit (2) or error (3)

426.description: The request did not ask to upgrade to bird-tty or websocket

get.summary: Open an interactive terminal in a running machine

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The command as a JSON array of strings, like `["psql","-U","postgres"]`

parameters.name: machine
parameters.description: Machine id, or the end of one; left out, the first running machine

101.description: Switched to bird-tty: both sides send frames of a kind byte, a big-endian u32 length and the payload; data (0) both ways, resize (1, cols and rows as u16) from the client, then exit (2, i32 code) or error (3, text) from birdd. Browsers can upgrade to websocket instead, which carries the same frames in binary messages

426.description: The request did not ask to upgrade to bird-tty or websocket

get.summary: Read or follow logs

parameters.name: tail
parameters.description: Number of recent lines per machine, default 100, at most 10000

parameters.name: follow
parameters.description:
Keep the response open and stream new lines as they are written, also from machines that
start later, like replacements from a deploy

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only lines written after this unix time in seconds; tail still caps how many

200.description: Recent log lines; with follow=true a newline-delimited JSON stream of LogEntry

get.summary: How the proxy treats the service's requests

200.description: The service's proxy settings

put.summary: Replace the service's proxy settings; they apply to the next request

200.description: Saved and in effect

post.summary: Restart a service's machines one at a time

200.description: Every running machine restarted and passed its health check

409.description: Conflicting state or operation in progress

502.description: A machine did not pass its health check

post.summary: Roll back to an earlier deployment

200.description: Earlier image, port and variables deployed again

409.description: Conflicting state or operation in progress

502.description: The app did not become healthy; includes its last log lines

post.summary: Run a command in a new container from the service's image

parameters.name: command

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The command as a JSON array of strings, like `["rails","console"]`

101.description: Switched to bird-tty, like the exec terminal; the container is removed when the session ends

426.description: The request did not ask to upgrade to bird-tty or websocket

409.description: Services with volumes run a single machine

storage.description: Where the archives are kept, such as local

trigger.description: manual, or restore for the copy taken automatically before a restore

oneOf.description: Output exactly as written, so a chunk may end mid-line; invalid UTF-8 becomes U+FFFD
Service name, defaults to the template name

CreateProject.description: A new project, which starts with a `production` environment

oneOf.description: Org that owns it; left out, the one org you administer, or `default` for server admins

expires_in_days.description: Days until the token stops working; left out, it works until deleted

CreatedUser.description: The new user and a first token for them, shown only this once

oneOf.description: Seconds a run may take, or text like "30m"; left out, an hour

next_run_at.description: Unix seconds of the next scheduled run, in UTC

CronRunDetail.description: A run with the end of what it printed, or why it did not run

CronSchedule.description: A 5-field cron pattern in UTC like */15 * * * *, or an alias like @daily

DeployEvent.description:
One line of the newline-delimited json a deploy answers with when asked for
`application/x-ndjson`; it ends with deployed or failed

DeployLogKind.description: Where a line of a deploy's log came from

seq.description: Counts from 0 within the deploy, so a follower can tell what it has seen

oneOf.description: Back the volumes up on a schedule; left out, an existing schedule is kept
Command to run instead of the image's; left out, an existing service keeps its saved one
CPU limit in thousandths of a core; left out, a new service gets 1000 and an existing one keeps its limit

cron.description: The service's cron jobs once the deploy succeeds, replacing the ones it had; left out, they stay as they are

default_command.description: Forget the saved command and run the image's own again; not together with `command`

oneOf.description: Seconds a new machine has to pass its health check; left out, a new service gets 60 and an existing one keeps its timeout
Memory limit in MiB; left out, a new service gets 1024 and an existing one keeps its limit

no_release.description: Forget the saved release command; not together with `release`

oneOf.description: Command run once in a new container before machines start, like migrations; a failure stops the deploy. Left out, an existing service keeps its saved one
Machines to run; left out, a new service gets 1 and an existing one keeps its count

done.description: False while the deploy is still running

password.description: Needed when turning off your own; admins resetting someone else's leave it out

oneOf.description: Visitors are sent to this other domain of the service instead of the app

machine.description: Machine id, or the end of one as `bird status` shows it; left out, the first running machine

HealthCheck.description: http (any HTTP response on /), tcp (accepts connections) or a path like /healthz that must answer 2xx

oneOf.description: Served over https; http redirects to it
birdd is asking for a certificate
The last request failed and is retried at `retry_at`, both in unix seconds
birdd runs without an acme directory, so it serves plain http only
`*.localhost` names never get certificates

token.description: The secret to send as a bearer token

at.description: When podman recorded the line, in unix milliseconds

code.description: A code from the authenticator app or a recovery code, for users with two-factor on

cookie.description: Keep the session in an `HttpOnly` cookie instead of returning its token, for browsers

oneOf.description: The session token to send as a bearer token, shown only this once
Signed in with the session in a cookie, which scripts cannot read
The password was right; send it again with a code

cpu_millicores.description: Thousandths of a core in use, measured over half a second

history.description:
CPU and memory every 30 seconds over the last hour birdd watched it, oldest first; only
sent with stats

oneOf.description: Only sampled when asked for, and only for running machines

updated_at.description: When the machine entered its current state, in unix seconds

cpu_millicores.description: Thousandths of a core in use, averaged since the point before

oneOf.description: Your role in it; server admins see every org, also ones they do not belong to

ProxySettings.description: How bird's proxy treats one service's requests; the default changes nothing

cloudflare.description:
Take the visitor from `CF-Connecting-IP` on requests from Cloudflare's addresses, for
rate limits and `X-Forwarded-For`

headers.description: Response headers set on every answer, replacing the app's

maintenance.description: Answer 503 instead of passing requests to the app

oneOf.description: Largest request body in MiB, 100 when unset
Requests each visitor may make, counted per IP address (IPv6 per /64)

security_headers.description: Add HSTS on https, nosniff, frame and referrer policies unless the app sets them

oneOf.description: Seconds the app has to start answering, 60 when unset

burst.description: Requests allowed at once before the sustained rate applies

RecoveryCodes.description: Single-use codes for signing in without the authenticator, shown only this once

insecure.description: Talk plain http and skip certificate checks, only for registries on a private network

ResponseHeaders.description: Header names are lowercase, values printable ASCII

allow_image_change.description: Restore data written by a different image than the service runs now

safety_backup.description: Backup of the data that was replaced, to undo the restore

skip_entrypoint.description: Run the command itself instead of passing it to the image's entrypoint

oneOf.description: Command the machines run instead of the image's own; left out, the image's
The newest deployment when it failed; an older active one may still be serving

references.description: Services in the same environment whose variables this one reads

oneOf.description: Runs once per deploy before new machines start

state.description: Stopped services keep their machines stopped until started again

current.description: The session this request came in with
Needed when changing your own password once you have one; admins resetting someone else's leave it out

oneOf.description: Variable other services reference to connect, like `DATABASE_URL`

TokenSummary.description: A token as it is listed; the secret itself is never shown again

TwoFactorSetup.description: The secret to add to an authenticator app, by its uri as a qr code or by hand

oneOf.description: Another domain of the same service to redirect to, or null to serve the app again

deployed.description: What the running deployment received after resolving references, if it has this variable

value.description: The stored value, references and all

Whoami.description: Who the request's token belongs to; the token from birdd's data dir is `root`
